IN.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal / helpline 1930

agencies.name: Internal Revenue Service
never_does: call to demand immediate payment by gift card, prepaid debit card or wire transfer
ask for or accept gift cards as payment for a tax bill
demand payment without giving you the chance to question or appeal the amount
threaten to have police, immigration officers or other law enforcement arrest you for not paying
threaten to revoke your driver's license, business licenses or immigration status

agencies.name: Social Security Administration
never_does: contact you unexpectedly to ask for personal information or bank account details
threaten to suspend your Social Security number or seize your bank account
tell you to transfer or move your money to protect it
demand payment by gift cards, gold, prepaid debit cards, payment apps, cryptocurrency, wire transfers or cash
ask you to keep secrets
ask for sensitive or personal information through social media, email or text message

agencies.name: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
never_does: ask you to transfer money to an individual
accept Western Union, MoneyGram, PayPal, Venmo or gift cards as payment for immigration fees
ask you to pay fees to a person on the phone or by email
contact you through your personal social media accounts
routinely email you to say you have been approved for a visa or other immigration benefit

agencies.name: Medicare (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)
aliases: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services
never_does: call you uninvited and ask for personal or private information
call you to sell you anything or visit you at your home
threaten to cancel your health benefits to get your information or money

agencies.name: United States Postal Service
never_does: text or email you about a package unless you first requested tracking with a tracking number
put a link in its tracking texts or emails
charge for package tracking

agencies.name: Income Tax Department

phones.label: Demand Facilitation Centre outbound (calls to taxpayers come from this number)

never_does: ask for detailed personal information by email
email you asking for PINs, passwords or similar access details for cards, bank or other financial accounts
send a valid notice, order or letter without a DIN (Document Identification Number)

agencies.name: Unique Identification Authority of India (Aadhaar)
never_does: ask you to disclose your Aadhaar OTP
ask you to share your mAadhaar PIN
claim money can be withdrawn from your bank account just because someone knows your Aadhaar number
agencies.note: The OTP and PIN items are UIDAI advice to residents (never disclose them), not a statement about UIDAI's own calls.

agencies.name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation
never_does: request personal information such as Aadhaar, PAN or bank details over the phone
contact members or pensioners to ask for any money to be deposited
ask you to share your OTP on a call

agencies.name: e-Challan (Parivahan traffic challans)
aliases: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
never_does: ask for your password or OTP by call, email, message or link
ask for payment details or sensitive personal information by call, email, message or link
ask you to pay through a website or app other than its official portal or app

agencies.name: India Post
never_does: send you to any website other than www.indiapost.gov.in
need your OTP through a link
need your banking, card or UPI details through a link
agencies.note: All three items come from India Post's fraud alert, which is advice to customers rather than a 'we never' statement.

agencies.name: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India / Department of Telecommunications
never_does: contact you about disconnecting your mobile number, by message or any other way
authorise any third-party agency to contact you about disconnection
conduct investigations against individual consumers
ask for Aadhaar, bank account, OTP or other personal details
issue arrest threats or warnings over digital platforms
agencies.note: No TRAI call line is listed. Disconnection for billing, KYC or misuse is done by your own telecom provider, so confirm with its customer care.

agencies.name: Central Bureau of Investigation

phones.label: CBI New Delhi (queries or complaints about people posing as CBI)
CBI New Delhi (queries or complaints about people posing as CBI)

never_does: place anyone under "digital arrest" or demand money over phone or video calls (true of police and every government agency)
offer to settle complaints or cases in exchange for money or favours
certify or validate foreign remittances or fund transfers

agencies.name: HM Revenue & Customs

phones.label: Income Tax enquiries from outside the UK

never_does: leave a voicemail threatening legal action
threaten arrest
ask you to pay with gift or payment vouchers
contact you on WhatsApp, apart from one-way UK Government Channel alerts
agencies.note: gov.uk is shared by all UK government departments; a gov.uk match confirms UK government, not HMRC specifically.

agencies.name: Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency
never_does: send emails asking you to confirm personal details or payment information
send texts about vehicle tax refunds
ask for bank or credit card details by text message or email
ask you to get in touch to claim a vehicle tax refund (refunds are automatic)
use a contact centre number that does not begin with 0300
agencies.note: gov.uk is shared by all UK government departments; a gov.uk match confirms UK government, not DVLA specifically.
